name: shopify-s3-bq-bridge
description: Daily sync from Peppermayo's five Shopify storefronts (AU, US, UK, CA, EU) to a BigQuery warehouse, via S3. Contains the extraction Lambda, historical backfill script, and the SQL that drives the BigQuery Data Transfer + scheduled MERGE upserts.
author: Ritchie Vincent

scripts.build: npm run verify:schema && rm -rf dist lambda.zip && mkdir -p dist && cp -R src dist/ && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && (cd dist && npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund) && (cd dist && zip -qr ../lambda.zip src node_modules) && rm -rf dist
